summary.goal: Enable click-to-edit for all plan fields without modals or page navigation
summary.context: Editing happens in place. Click to edit, blur to save. No modal for simple changes. The plan is always visible while you work on it. Progressive disclosure: expand for complex edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: Click on plan title enters edit mode
Click on goal enters edit mode
Click on step title/description enters edit mode
Blur or Enter saves the change
Optimistic UI updates immediately, rollback on error
Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd+S to save, Cmd+Z to undo

steps.title: Create EditableText component
steps.description: Reusable component for inline text editing. Shows text, click enters edit mode, blur/enter saves.

acceptance_criteria.description: Click enters edit mode with input

steps.title: Create EditableTextarea component
steps.description: Like EditableText but for multi-line content (descriptions, goals).

steps.title: Create PlanHeader component with inline editing
steps.description: Plan header with editable title and goal using EditableText/Textarea.

steps.title: Implement optimistic updates
steps.description: Update UI immediately on edit, rollback on API error with toast notification.

acceptance_criteria.description: On error, value reverts to previous

steps.title: Implement undo functionality
steps.description: Track edit history, Cmd+Z undoes last change locally.

steps.title: Add visual feedback for editable fields
steps.description: Subtle hover states indicating fields are editable. Cursor changes, slight highlight.

steps.title: Add tests for inline editing
steps.description: Unit tests for editable components, integration tests for edit flows.
